description: Complete listing detail page (DET-01, DET-02) with pixel-perfect gallery, price badge, specs table, description, map placeholder, seller card with trust badges, similar listings carousel, contact/chat/offer/report/share/favorite buttons, breadcrumb, status ribbon overlays, and fullscreen gallery modal with zoom, swipe, video placeholder, and image counter.
steps: 1. Enhance ListingDetailPage.tsx image gallery: add status ribbon overlay (Sold/Rented/Expired) using StatusBadge + absolute positioning, ensure ribbon appears on cover image when present.

2. Add DET-02 fullscreen lightbox/modal component: clicking image count (e.g., '3/8') opens fullscreen modal with active image, zoom to 150%/200% buttons (or pinch on mobile), left/right arrows for swipe (or swipe gesture), video play button placeholder (Video icon, no real video support), image counter display, close button (X), keyboard arrow key support.
3. Enhance breadcrumb: add proper navigation via router (Home > Category > Title), clickable links, handle long titles with line-clamp.
4. Complete specs table: 2-column grid on desktop, single column on mobile; key/value pairs from listing.specs with EAV structure; handle missing specs gracefully.
5. Add market price insights section: show lowest/average/highest price range with visual indicator (gradient bar with marker at current price); use formatPrice utility; add disclaimer text.
6. Complete location section: replace placeholder grid with styled mock map (radial gradient + marker icon + location label overlay), non-interactive.

7. Complete seller card (sidebar): show seller avatar, name (clickable to /seller/:name), rating stars + numeric rating, member-since date, verified badge if applicable, 'View Details' button to seller profile, 'View Business' button if listing.businessId exists, action buttons (Call, Message, WhatsApp), Block button (mock).
8. Add similar listings carousel (horizontal scroll, 5 max): filter by category, exclude self, slice first 5.
9. Add recently viewed carousel (from localStorage 'marbou-recent'): fetch and render like similar listings.

10. Add reviews section: show business rating + count if business exists, review list with avatar + author + rating + text + date, reply (if exists) indented; 'Write Review' button opens modal; modal has star picker (1-5), textarea, submit button.
11. Add safety tips section (warning-50 bg): bullet points on meeting, inspecting, paying.
12. Ensure all sections support AR/EN: listing title, description, specs keys/values, seller name, breadcrumb labels, button text.
13. Add loading skeleton for images; empty state if no images.
14. Mobile sticky footer: Contact bar fixed to bottom-16 (above nav) with Call + Message buttons on md:hidden.
acceptance_criteria: Fullscreen lightbox opens on image count click; displays current image, arrows navigate, counter shows '3/8', close button (X) returns to detail page.
Status ribbons (Sold/Rented/Expired) appear on cover image and detail header.
Specs table shows 2 columns on desktop, 1 on mobile; all EAV attributes render with keys/values.
Market price insights section displays lowest/average/highest prices with gradient range bar and marker.
Seller card shows all info: avatar, name (clickable), rating + count, member since, verified badge, View Details + View Business buttons, Call/Message/WhatsApp/Block buttons.
Similar listings carousel scrolls horizontally, shows 5 max, each a ListingCard; no scroll on mobile if < 3 items.
Recently viewed carousel renders same way.
Reviews section shows business rating (if exists), review list with replies, Write Review button opens modal with star picker and textarea.
Safety tips section visible with icon and bullet points.
AR/EN switching: all text translates, layout mirrors (text-align, flex direction, arrow icon direction).
Breadcrumb navigates via router; long titles truncate with ellipsis.
Mobile contact bar sticks to bottom; desktop shows in sidebar.
verification: npm run typecheck — no errors in ListingDetailPage.

npm run dev — visit /listing/lst-001 (or any valid ID from mockData). Confirm full detail page loads, image gallery displays, status ribbon visible, click image counter, fullscreen modal opens, arrow keys navigate, close button works.
Click breadcrumb links; confirm navigation works. Switch to AR; confirm RTL layout and Arabic text.
Scroll to seller card; click 'View Details' → /seller/:name, 'View Business' → /business/:id.
Scroll through specs table, market price section, reviews. Click 'Write Review', fill form, submit; confirm review appears in list.
On mobile, verify sticky contact bar at bottom; call/message buttons functional (show toast).
Observe loading skeleton while images load; test with invalid listing ID, confirm empty state with 'No Results' message.
